title: Privacy
description: What this website collects, why, and what you can ask us. No cookies, no tracking across sites.
lead: This page covers implesta.com, the website. [[Have this page reviewed by a lawyer before launch, and add the privacy terms for the Implesta app.]]

paragraphs: We count visits with Plausible Analytics, which sets no cookies and stores no personal data. We see which pages are read, from which country and which website a visitor came from, never who you are. Because nothing is stored on your device, there is no cookie banner.
We ask for your name, work email and team size, so we can prepare the call. Bookings are handled by Cal.com. [[Where Cal.com stores the data, and how long we keep it.]]
You can ask what we hold about you, have it corrected or deleted, at {email}. You can also complain to the Belgian Data Protection Authority.
How customer data is stored and protected in the app itself is described on [security and data](page:security).
